products.description:
Gigabyte AI TOP ATOM ATAGB10-9000 Personal AI Supercomputer

The Gigabyte AI TOP ATOM ATAGB10-9000 Personal AI Supercomputer is a next-generation desktop AI system designed for researchers, developers, and enterprises working with advanced machine learning and deep learning workloads. Powered by NVIDIA’s Grace Blackwell Superchip, this Gigabyte AI PC delivers unmatched computational power, scalability, and connectivity in an ATX form factor.

Extreme AI Processing Power

At its core, the Gigabyte AI TOP ATOM ATAGB10-9000 features a 20-core Arm CPU (10 Cortex-X925 + 10 Cortex-A725) paired with the NVIDIA GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip. This architecture ensures seamless AI acceleration, delivering up to 1 petaFLOP of tensor performance for large-scale model training and inference. Unified 128GB LPDDR5x system memory with 256-bit interface and 273 GB/s bandwidth provides lightning-fast data access for complex workloads.

Advanced Graphics and Storage

Equipped with NVIDIA Blackwell architecture graphics, the Gigabyte AI TOP ATOM ATAGB10-9000 offers cutting-edge GPU performance for deep learning, simulation, and visualization. Storage is future-ready with a massive 4TB M.2 NVMe PCIe 5.0 SSD, ensuring ultra-fast read/write speeds for datasets and applications. Expansion slots include PCIe 5.0 x16, PCIe 5.0 x8, PCIe 4.0 x4, and multiple M.2 slots for additional upgrades.

Connectivity and Networking

Networking is powered by NVIDIA ConnectX-7 NIC with 10GbE Ethernet, Wi-Fi 7, and Bluetooth 5.4, ensuring high-speed data transfer and low-latency communication. External I/O includes USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C ports (up to 20Gbps), HDMI 2.1a, and a Kensington Nano slot for security. This makes the Gigabyte AI Supercomputer ideal for collaborative AI development environments.

Operating System and Software

The Gigabyte AI TOP ATOM ATAGB10-9000 runs on NVIDIA DGX OS and Ubuntu Linux, optimized for AI research and deployment. With support for high-definition audio and advanced expansion, it is tailored for professionals building and deploying AI models at scale.

Compact Yet Powerful Design

Built in an ATX form factor with a 240W adapter, the Gigabyte AI TOP ATOM ATAGB10-9000 Personal AI Supercomputer combines efficiency with raw computational power. It is the ultimate solution for AI researchers, data scientists, and enterprises seeking a Gigabyte AI PC with unmatched acceleration.
